name: Every product behaves as an app
principle: Phone interaction is the primary product behavior, not a reduced desktop webpage.

requiredChecks.phoneViewport: Core content and actions fit common narrow phone viewports without sideways scrolling.
requiredChecks.touchTargets: Primary controls are comfortably usable by touch and do not overlap.
requiredChecks.safeAreas: Fixed controls respect screen cutouts, browser chrome, and device safe areas.
requiredChecks.keyboardOpen: Forms remain usable when the software keyboard covers part of the screen.
requiredChecks.backNavigation: Back navigation closes the current layer or returns predictably without losing work.
requiredChecks.stateRestoration: Reload, backgrounding, and return preserve appropriate user state.
requiredChecks.loadingAndOffline: Loading, failure, retry, and offline states explain what is happening and preserve input.
requiredChecks.portraitAndLandscape: Core actions remain available in portrait and landscape.

releaseRule: A failed required check creates an error-memory case and blocks production-ready status.
